title: Rewards
empty: Nothing yet. When you hand a nearby payment in and it's credited, the fee shows up here.
trust: Tips are paid on trust. The network checks that a tip is real, not that you carried the payment: the payer and the service that credits it decide. Only the phone that hands the payment in gets the tip; phones that pass it along get nothing.
waiting: Delivered a payment · fee {{amount}} {{symbol}}, waiting to be paid

notPaid.not_delivered: Not paid: the payment was not delivered
notPaid.not_added: Not paid: the server didn't add it. Contact support
notPaid.unknown: Not paid: the network did not accept this tip

claimBody: The claim goes to a new address. On the blockchain it isn't linked to the payments you carried. The service that submits it sees your network address.
claimDelayedNote: It is sent at a random time within a day.
claimNowNote: Sending at once is easier to link to the payments you carried.
moveWarning: Moving to your wallet links these rewards to that wallet on the blockchain.
tipSwitch: Tip people who carry my payments
tipNeedsBond: Tipping needs a security deposit of at least 32 USDC.
tipReview: Delivery tip · up to {{amount}} {{symbol}}, paid only if your payment is credited

notification.title: You earned a fee
notification.body: A payment you carried was handed in. The fee is paid once the network has it.
notification.bodyAmount: A payment you carried was handed in: {{amount}} {{symbol}}. The fee is paid once the network has it.

problem.read: Couldn’t read the rewards. Try again.
problem.readTipping: Couldn’t read the tipping setting. Try again.
